description: Uncompressed, self-contained original packing codes and metadata. Self symmetry allows proper rotation after reflection and permutation of piece names, with extras preserved as a separate group.
sourceMetadataEncoding: sourceMembership, sourceFamily and pieces preserve original CSV columns and string values; masks in decoded records are integers

schema.piece_order: source mask order; bit 0 = first piece
schema.lowercase_planar: not contained in one exterior face; j and s mean JL and SZ
schema.score_encoding: one hexadecimal composition code per piece, sorted for packing score
schema.family_model: outer-face-turn endpoint reachability, monochrome groups, arbitrary piece names, extras separate, proper whole-cube rotations
